metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a glance at Saturday's sheet, the lease, Navarre, and the thimble.

yesterday: Four-and-twenty pound a year, where they pay fourteen. Two years less a month. You did not read the clause. Nothing is agreed.
You did not curse Allen. You have not seen him. You said the king is long.
Item, a thimble of silver, two shillings and sixpence.
Saturday's sheet still says the king is come home. You added nothing this morning. The three words on the tables stayed as they were.
